settings.tagline: Giving the entertainment world an Arabic voice
settings.description: Belfay Studios is a Beirut dubbing house specialized in Arabic dubbing, voiceover, subtitling and localization for film, TV, games and e-learning.
settings.footerText: Arabic dubbing, voiceover, subtitling and localization recorded in our Beirut studios by actors, translators and sound editors with more than 25 years of experience.
